content: Feature: Enhanced `Premake` CLI wrapper with configurable Lua file path, and support for custom command-line arguments. [#17398](https://github.com/conan-io/conan/pull/17398) . Docs [here](https://github.com/conan-io/docs/pull/4000)

github.content:
### GitHub Pull Request #17398 [Feature] Added features to the premake cli wrapper
Changelog: Feature: Enhanced ``Premake`` CLI wrapper with configurable Lua file path, and support for custom command-line arguments.  
Docs: https://github.com/conan-io/docs/pull/4000

- premake5 action (vsXXXX or gmake2) gets auto-detected in constructor but can be changed via public member. 
- The path and filename to the root `premake5.lua` file is changeable
- Custom premake5 command line arguments can be specified via public dict `arguments`

Thees changes are required in order to fully support calling the premake5 executable. This lays the foundation for a `PremakeToolchain`. 

This is one of the key components of #14724 but in a modified version. I plan to add the other main feature (build) as a follow up under `PremakeToolchain`. As I have understand as long as premake does not have a build feature. Which it does not have. It should be "chained" as a Toolchain that would utilize the cli wrapper and the platform specific build system wrapper (`MSBuild` or a direct `make` call) other than being integrated in the cli wrapper. Correct?

Would we need to add any test coverage other than the "basic" test @memsharded added? Like checking that arguments work etc.)

Currently there is (as previously discussed) no documentation for the whole premake feature set. I assume we will stay like this for now. I would however recommend to document the feature as soon as premake is feature complete.

content: Fix: Improve untar performance. [#17708](https://github.com/conan-io/conan/pull/17708)

github.content:
### GitHub Pull Request #17708 Fix 200% untar progress issue by avoiding a second read of file
Changelog: Fix: Improve untar performance.
Docs: omit

Calling `TarFile.getmembers()` forces a complete IO read of the tar file.
The same happens when calling `TarFile.extractall(members=members)` for the first time.

This PR aims to fix the reported issue of having untar progress exceeding 100% occasionated by calling `seek(0)` twice, one in the first read querying all files and a second for the actual uncompression.

### Details:
Perform the decompression in a single IO loop by iterating over compressed files without actually reading them, filtering and uncompressing when needed one at a time.
